Package com.csse3200.game.entities.factories

Class HitboxSpec

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.entities.factories.HitboxSpec
public class HitboxSpec extends Object
Fluent spawn configuration for HitboxFactory.createHitbox(HitboxSpec).

Melee weapons should set owner(Entity) so the sensor follows the wielder. Bow splash should omit owner so the hitbox stays in world space.

      public HitboxSpec visualScale(com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 visualScale)
      Draw size for the sprite, independent of size(Vector2). Hitboxes are sized for collision, so without this a square sprite is squashed into an oblong sensor.
